task.description: TEST-RUNNER ran the full suite for real via scripts/test_parallel.sh (N=8 partitions, real Postgres via docker compose, real asdf-managed Elixir/OTP toolchain). The 2 failures are both in Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest's 'rust pin (REQ-165)' describe block (test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs lines 274 and 289), both raising `** (ErlangError) Erlang error: :enoent` from `System.cmd("rustc", ["--version"], ...)` before any assertion runs -- confirmed directly that `rustc` is not on PATH in this sandbox (`which rustc` exits 1) even though `.tool-versions` pins `rust 1.97.1`, unlike elixir/erlang which did resolve to real asdf shims for this run. All prior gates already passed with real toolchain verification: design, security review (tenant-scoping and no field leaks confirmed), code review, test design (5 real gaps found/filled), test-design validation (4 real mutations confirmed caught, including a before/after-state-swap catch and a structural tenant-scoping proof). Full test-runner report with exact combined counts and per-failure diagnosis at handoffs/WF02-REQ196-20260830/test-run-report-20260830.md.
